market.question: Will the highest temperature in Buenos Aires be 16°C on May 2?

assessment.reasoning: Buenos Aires May 2 forecast high ~19°C. Question asks for 16°C exact bin (16.0-16.9°C). 16°C is 3°C below forecast - cold tail. Possible if a strong cold front, but unlikely given current forecast. Probability ~0.08-0.12.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cold front could push temps lower; relatively narrow 1°C bin reduces probability further.
